KörkortGo · Before you begin
Before you begin
This material is a learning aid to help you understand Swedish driving theory. It is not an
official source and cannot replace official information from Trafikverket and
Transportstyrelsen. Always consult their current guidance and the applicable rules.
This book is for English-speaking learners preparing for ordinary Swedish category B driving. It
connects rules with decisions you can explain and practise. It does not grant permission to drive,
replace mandatory training or supervised practice, reproduce official examination questions, or
guarantee a test result.
How to use this book
Begin with modules 1–3. They establish personal readiness, vehicle preparation and road
interpretation. Use modules 4–7 to apply that foundation in traffic and changing conditions.
Modules 8–9 develop responsibility for the vehicle, its load and the journey's impact. Module 10
brings the learning together.
Each lesson contains a goal, an explanation, an original worked situation, a knowledge check
with its answer, and a short reminder. After each module, write a reflection and use it to plan
your next study or supervised practice session. Explain the answer before reading it; then change
one condition in the example and consider whether your decision would change.

KörkortGo · How to use this book
Read, reflect and practise
Read the labels
Requirements describe applicable duties or conditions, with official references. Official
recommendations/advice describe the named authority's guidance. Learning approaches,
worked decisions and review guides are original teaching material. They help you apply the
principles; they are not additional laws. English explanations are written for learning and do not
replace the Swedish legal wording.
Use the official references
References appear beside factual material. Trafikverket and Transportstyrelsen provide the
main guidance. Official legislation and other public authorities supply details missing from the
main agency guidance. Selected manufacturer handbooks supply missing technical cautions
and are listed separately. The lessons identify source limits and distinguish recommendations,
research and teaching inferences from legal duties. Use the handbook for the actual vehicle; a
generic example is not its operating procedure.
Check current guidance
Original licensing, examination and vehicle checks are dated 1 October 2026; added passages
have their own checks on 12–13 October. Check current official information before using a
time-sensitive rule. Hypothetical numbers in examples are identified as such and are not
measurements of your vehicle or personal performance.
